title: Cobblemon Ditto HMs
description: Ditto's Pokopia-inspired HM abilities for Cobblemon - 34 learnable HMs (24 active + 10 toggles) taught by Pokemon.
body:
# Cobblemon Ditto HMs

Bring Ditto's **Pokopia HM abilities** into Cobblemon! **34 learnable HMs** (24 active + 10 toggles), each taught by specific Pokemon.

## How it works
1. Hold an ability's **trigger item** and **sneak + right-click** the right Pokemon to receive its **HM Disc**.
2. **Right-click the disc** to learn the ability permanently (it stays as a reusable badge).
3. Manage everything from the crafteable **HM Case** (drag to reorder, right-click to use/toggle).

> Which Pokemon teaches each HM is part of the fun - it's documented only in the wiki, never shown in-game.

## Highlights
- **24 active HMs** - Cut, Fly, Teleport, Explosion, Thunder, Camouflage, Crabhammer, Revival Blessing and more.
- **10 toggle HMs** - Surf, Dive, Glide, Rock Climb, Mean Look, Harden, Burning Bulwark and more, each with its own HUD icon.
- Custom **TM-style HM disc art**, particles and sounds for every ability.
- Fully **configurable** hunger / cooldown / power per ability (command + Cloth Config screen).

**Requires Cobblemon.** Available for **Fabric** and **NeoForge** on Minecraft **1.21.1**.

- Wiki: https://manucruzleiva.github.io/cobblemon-ditto-hms/
